body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> San Disk presented ‘Sansa Express’, its new 1GB cable-free flash-based mp3 player with SD card slot and direct USB 2.0 connectivity.
It features 1.1-inch OLED screen, FM tuner, voice recording, 15 hours of battery life.
It is expected to be available in March 2007 at 59.99(USD).
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Niki Hwang, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Sirh >
